gaps.description: Lake reflection reads dim (dark teal at most) because REFLECT_SCALE 0.55 is applied to the same AURORA_STOPS; this is the spec's fixed constant, not tuned for visibility.
Treeline colour (2,10,6) is darker than the night ground (3,7,17), so the conifers read only as a dark notch where aurora or airglow sits behind them, not as distinct shapes.

statement: Measured: aurora colour family fraction top half 0.0893, non black bottom half 0.0958, no horizontal overflow, fps 60. Focal point is the aurora; title, chips and HUD stay quiet in the top band above the horizon. Two gaps recorded above.
